hero_lede: Medicine Anytime Anywhere. We're a telemedicine platform connecting patients with locally-licensed doctors in the markets where we operate. No call centres, no waiting rooms, no surprise fees. You see who you're booking, what it costs, and when they're free.
p1_body: Every clinician on the platform is licensed in your country. No off-shore call centres, no rota of strangers. The doctor on the profile is the doctor on the call.
p2_body: Pick a date, pick a time, pay securely at checkout. Confirmed instantly. No upfront forms, no insurance pre-auth, no 'we'll call you back within 5 business days'.
p3_body: Your data lives in EU data centres. We don't sell it, we don't profile you, we don't share it with insurers. The only people who see your records are the doctor on your call and you.
s1_title: Pick a country, then a service
s1_body: Click your flag. Browse general consultations, specialist consultations, or home tests. Prices and durations are listed up front.
s2_body: Every doctor's profile lists qualifications, languages, registration body. Pick a date from the rail, pick a time on that date.
s3_body: Stripe processes your payment at booking. Your consultation is confirmed immediately after payment. Prices are shown in full before you book, with no hidden fees.
s4_title: Get referrals, certificates, or test kits at home
s4_body: Where clinically appropriate, the doctor can issue referrals, certificates, or follow-up guidance. Notes are shared after the consultation according to the service and country workflow.
mission_p1: For the patient who moved countries and can’t find a doctor who speaks their language or understands their health history. For the professional whose schedule makes a 9am GP appointment impossible. For the parent trying to get their child seen without taking a day off work. For the person who simply shouldn’t have to wait three weeks for something that takes twenty minutes.
mission_p2: We built Global Health to close the gap between the healthcare system people have and the healthcare experience they deserve. Founded in 2023 in Prague, operating across multiple markets in Europe and Latin America, Global Health connects patients with locally-registered doctors who work within the same regulatory framework as a GP or specialist in their country.
mission_p3: Acting local at a global scale. A place where patients feel comfortable with their healthcare wherever they are, whether they’ve lived there all their life or just arrived. Trusted, efficient, safe, and built for real people.
